title: Another Look at Bandwidth-free Inference: a Sample Splitting Approach
summary: The bandwidth-free tests/inferences for a multi-dimensional parameter have attracted considerable attention in econometrics and statistics literature. These tests can be conveniently implemented due to their tuning-parameter free nature and possess more accurate size as compared to the traditional HAC-based approaches, where consistent long run variance estimation was involved.
